Key audit matter:
Credit risk and impairment of loans and advances
to customers
The directors make complex and subjective
judgements over both timing of recognition of
impairment and the estimation of the magnitude of
such impairment. Judgement is applied in determining
the appropriate parameters and assumptions to
calculate the impairment.
These judgements together with the magnitude of
the loans and advances balances requires significant
audit focus.
How our audit addressed the Key audit ma:
Identification of loans subject to specific impairment provisions
The identification of loans subject to specific impairment testing
is reliant on manual and automated controls over the information
systems. We tested loan account creation, approval and restriction
of access to modify standing data over loans. We also tested that
the system is configured to accurately identify past due loans and
calculate the number of days past due accurately.
We obtained a detailed loans listing and performed credit file
reviews and tested performance of the loans during the year to
check whether they were active and being paid as per the loan
agreement and to confirm that they are appropriately classified.
